lead: Editable Word templates for policies, procedures, contracts, consent forms and governance. Each one has model wording, highlighted fields to fill in and guidance boxes to help you adapt it to your organisation and country.

categories.name: Policies
categories.lead: Policies state the principles and rules your organisation follows. They set expectations for decisions, behaviour and accountability across a topic.
categories.intro: Each policy comes with model wording, the commitments funders and partners look for, and clear steps for reporting and responding. Adapt it, have it approved, and review it every year.

categories.name: Procedures
categories.lead: Procedures explain the steps people take to carry out a policy or handle a recurring situation. They make responsibilities, handoffs and records clear.
categories.intro: Each procedure sets out who does what and by when, with logs, forms and letter wording in the annexes, so your team can act quickly when it matters.

categories.name: Contracts & agreements
categories.lead: Contracts and agreements record what parties expect from one another, including work, payment, information, rights and ways to end or resolve a relationship.
categories.intro: Each agreement has full clause wording, schedules and signature blocks, with guidance on the clauses that change most from country to country. Have the final version checked locally before anyone signs.

categories.name: Consent forms
categories.lead: Consent forms help people understand a specific activity or use of their information and record a clear choice where consent is appropriate.
categories.intro: Each form uses plain language, separate choices for each use, verbal and thumbprint options, and guidance for the person taking consent, including for children.

categories.name: Governance & compliance
categories.lead: Governance and compliance documents help leaders oversee decisions, keep records and check that required duties are being met.
categories.intro: Registers, checklists, terms of reference and assessments with worked examples, so your board and team can see who decides what and whether duties are being met.

templates.title: Anti-Harassment, Intimidation and Bullying Policy and Procedure
templates.description: How your organisation prevents harassment, sexual harassment, bullying, intimidation and discrimination, and how anyone can raise a concern and get a fair, timely and confidential response.

templates.title: Board Interest Declaration
templates.description: A declaration each board member completes when they join and every year, so that your organisation can see and manage any interest that could affect, or appear to affect, their judgement.

templates.title: Co-founder Agreement
templates.description: What the co-founders of your organisation agree about purpose, roles, decisions, ownership or governance seats, money and what happens if someone leaves, written down while everyone still gets on.

templates.title: Code of Conduct
templates.description: The standards everyone who works with or for your organisation agrees to: respect, honesty, care for the people you serve, and safety for everyone.

templates.title: Complaints and Feedback Procedure
templates.description: How anyone can tell your organisation what you are doing well and what you are getting wrong, safely and in a way that suits them, and how you respond, put things right and learn.

templates.title: Conflict of Interest Policy
templates.description: How your organisation identifies, declares, records and manages conflicts of interest, so that decisions are made fairly and in the organisation's best interests.

templates.title: Cookie Policy
templates.description: Explains to visitors which cookies and similar technologies your website uses, why, and how to accept, refuse or change them.

templates.title: Data Breach Response Procedure
templates.description: What your organisation does in the first hour, the first day and the first three days after personal information is lost, stolen, exposed or sent to the wrong person.

templates.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
templates.description: A short, step-by-step form your organisation uses to spot and reduce privacy risks before starting a new project, system or data sharing arrangement.

templates.title: Data Protection Policy
templates.description: How your organisation collects, uses, shares, protects and deletes personal information about the people you serve, your team and your supporters.

templates.title: Data Rights Request Procedure
templates.description: How your organisation recognises, logs and answers requests from people who want to see, correct, delete or control the personal information you hold about them.

templates.title: Data Sharing Agreement
templates.description: An agreement for your organisation and another organisation that share personal data, each deciding for itself how it uses that data. It sets out what is shared, why, how it is protected, and what each side does when something goes wrong.

templates.title: Delegation of Authority Matrix
templates.description: A single table of who at your organisation can approve which decisions, and up to what amount: spending, contracts, people, funding, banking, policies, legal matters and public statements.

templates.title: Employment Contract
templates.description: A clear written contract of employment for your organisation: the job, pay, hours, leave, conduct standards and how the employment can end, ready to adapt to the law where the employee works.

templates.title: Environmental Policy
templates.description: The practical steps your organisation takes to measure and reduce its environmental impact, to avoid harming the environment through its programmes, and to help the communities it serves cope with a changing climate.

templates.title: Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Policy
templates.description: How your organisation treats people fairly, welcomes difference and removes barriers, in the way you recruit and pay your team, run your programmes and involve the people you serve.

templates.title: Expenses and Per Diem Policy
templates.description: Clear, fair rules for what your organisation pays when people spend money or travel for its work, including per diems for staff, volunteers and the community members who take part in your activities.

templates.title: Financial Controls Policy
templates.description: The rules your organisation follows to plan, approve, pay, record and report every unit of money, so that funds are safe, used as agreed and easy to account for.

templates.title: Fraud, Bribery and Corruption Policy and Procedure
templates.description: How your organisation prevents, spots and responds to fraud, theft, bribery, corruption, money laundering and the misuse of funds, including a step-by-step fraud response plan.

templates.title: Fundraising and Communications Consent Form
templates.description: A supporter sign-up and donor consent form that lets people choose exactly how your organisation may contact them, records tax relief and regular gifts, and explains how their data is used.

templates.title: Gift Acceptance Policy
templates.description: How your organisation handles gifts and hospitality offered to or by its people, and how it decides which donations to accept, check, restrict, refuse or return.

templates.title: Governing Body Terms of Reference
templates.description: How your board of trustees, directors or management committee works: what it decides, who sits on it, how it meets, and how it oversees the people who run the organisation day to day.

templates.title: Incident Reporting Procedure
templates.description: What everyone at your organisation does when something goes wrong: keep people safe, report it quickly to the right person, tell the authorities and funders on time, and learn from it.

templates.title: Independent Contact Role Note
templates.description: Sets out the role of the trusted, independent person who receives concerns about the founder or safeguarding lead of your organisation, and covers urgent cases when the lead cannot be reached.

templates.title: Independent Contractor Agreement
templates.description: A clear agreement for your organisation to engage an individual consultant or freelancer: the work, fees, deadlines, ownership of what is produced, conduct standards and how either side can end it.

templates.title: Information Sharing Consent Form
templates.description: Records a person's choice about whether your organisation may share their information with named organisations, for example to refer them to other services.

templates.title: IT and Information Security Policy
templates.description: The practical rules your organisation follows to keep its accounts, devices and information safe: from passwords and phones to backups, AI tools and what happens when someone leaves.

templates.title: Legal Review Checklist
templates.description: A yes-or-no checklist that your organisation completes before adopting a new document, and once a year as a legal health check, and then takes to a lawyer or adviser with a short brief of questions.

templates.title: Mutual Confidentiality Agreement
templates.description: A short, balanced agreement that lets your organisation and another organisation share confidential information safely while they explore working together.

templates.title: Partner Due Diligence and Sanctions Screening Policy
templates.description: How your organisation gets to know its partners, sub-grantees, major suppliers and large donors, screens them against sanctions lists, and supports small local partners rather than excluding them.

templates.title: Partner Due Diligence Questionnaire
templates.description: A plain-language questionnaire for partners and sub-grantees, with a section for your organisation to record its risk assessment, conditions, support and approval.

templates.title: Partnership Memorandum of Understanding
templates.description: A memorandum of understanding (MOU) for two or more organisations working together. It records a shared purpose, who does what and how decisions are made, and states clearly which few commitments are legally binding.

templates.title: Photo and Story Consent Form
templates.description: A clear, fair way to ask people whether your organisation may use their photo, video, voice or story, for which purposes, and how they want to be identified.

templates.title: Privacy Notice
templates.description: Tells the people whose information your organisation holds what you collect, why, who you share it with, how long you keep it and how they can use their rights.

templates.title: Procurement Policy
templates.description: How your organisation buys goods, services and works fairly, openly and at the best value, so every purchase can stand up to a funder's audit.

templates.title: Records Retention Schedule
templates.description: How long your organisation keeps each type of record, who is responsible for it, and what happens when the time is up.

templates.title: Research Participation Consent Form
templates.description: An information sheet and consent form for people taking part in research, evaluations, surveys, interviews or focus groups run by your organisation.

templates.title: Reserves Policy
templates.description: Why your organisation holds reserves, how much it aims to hold, how it calculates its free reserves, and who can decide to build or use them.

templates.title: Risk Register
templates.description: How your organisation identifies, scores and manages the risks that could stop it achieving its mission, with a ready-to-use register, ten worked examples and short plans for the most serious risks.

templates.title: Safeguarding Policy and Procedure
templates.description: How your organisation keeps children, adults at risk and everyone you work with safe from harm, including sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment, and what you do when someone raises a concern.

templates.title: Services Agreement
templates.description: A clear contract for paid services between your organisation and another organisation. It works both ways: when you buy services from a supplier, and when you sell your own services to a client.

templates.title: Social Media and Communications Policy
templates.description: How your organisation runs its social media and public communications safely and honestly: who posts, how you protect the people in your stories, how staff use personal accounts, and what you do in a crisis.

templates.title: Sub-grant Agreement
templates.description: The agreement your organisation signs when it passes grant funds to a partner organisation to deliver a project. It covers the budget, payments in tranches, reporting, the head donor's conditions, compliance and what happens to unspent funds.

templates.title: Travel Safety and Duty of Care Policy
templates.description: How your organisation keeps people safe when they travel for its work: assessing risks before travel, staying in contact, responding to emergencies and giving everyone, local or international, the same care.

templates.title: Volunteer Agreement
templates.description: A volunteer role description and agreement for your organisation: what you offer your volunteers, what you ask of them, and how you look after each other, without creating an employment relationship.

templates.title: Website Terms of Use
templates.description: The terms that apply when people use your website, with optional sections for accounts, user content, online donations and a simple shop.

templates.title: Whistleblowing Policy and Procedure
templates.description: How anyone can raise a concern about wrongdoing at your organisation safely, including anonymously or outside the organisation, how you assess and investigate it, and how you protect the people who speak up.
